description: Workshop BCN - Mappatura POI Completa - Aree Wi Fi is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Il dataset espone la mappatura dei Punti di interesse ( POI ) individuati nella città di Bologna. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Regioni e città. Its keywords are PA alleata di cittadini e imprese, Città in 15 minuti. The portal shows 182 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
